poster_title: Tongyi DeepResearch: An Agentic Large Language Model for Deep Information-Seeking Research Tasks
authors: Tongyi DeepResearch Team; Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group

panels.headline: Autonomous multi-step reasoning and information seeking for deep research tasks
content: Advancement towards AGI drives the development of deep research agents.
Existing systems are often closed-source, limiting community access.
Lack of systematic methodology and publicly available models for deep research tasks.
General foundation models require costly human annotation for post-training.
Proposes an open-source solution to address these challenges.

panels.headline: End-to-end agentic training combining mid-training and post-training
content: Automated data synthesis pipeline for scalable agentic data generation.

panels.headline: High-quality data synthesis for agentic continual pre-training
content: Stage-specific environments for stable and consistent interactions.
Customized data synthesis pipeline for diverse, high-quality agent trajectories.
panels.figure_caption: Large-scale agent behavior data synthesis for agentic continual pre-training.

panels.headline: Performance on deep research benchmarks
content: Evaluated on benchmarks like Humanity's Last Exam, BrowseComp, WebWalkerQA, GAIA, xbench-DeepSearch, FRAMES, and xbench-DeepSearch-2510.
Compared with strong baselines such as OpenAI-o3 and Deepseek-V3.1.

panels.headline: Achieved state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters
content: Outperformed strong baselines in multiple deep research tasks.
Detailed evaluation results using Avg @3, Pass @1, and Pass @3 metrics.

panels.headline: Sets a new standard for deep research agents
content: Tongyi DeepResearch offers a systematic and scalable approach.
Open-sourcing the model and framework accelerates community research.
Relying on synthetic data may introduce biases.
Complexity in designing and maintaining customized environments.
Future work includes addressing limitations and expanding applications.
